instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In an open grassy field on an overcast day, the man in the black-and-white checkered shirt (R2) stands on the left, smiling warmly at the camera. Beside him, the man in the gray tie-dye jacket (R1) stands on the right, smiling while holding a blue-handled walking stick. They stand side-by-side, shoulder-to-shoulder on the muddy ground. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows across the natural green and gray landscape.
